task.description:
Author 3 UAT scenarios for Vortex Manufacturing GmbH.

Read the process definitions in tests/simulation/companies/vortex/:
- process_supplier_quality_deviation.yaml
- process_production_order_release.yaml

Read docs/agents/uat-scenario-schema.md for the required YAML format.
Read docs/simulation/companies/vortex/org_structure.yaml for actor IDs.

SCENARIO 1 — vortex-supplier-quality-deviation-critical.yaml (happy path)
Title: "Supplier quality deviation: CRITICAL path with 8D corrective action"
A Quality Engineer (Nina Vogt, actor-vortex-nina) logs a deviation for defective parts.
Quarantine fires (service-task).
Quality Manager (Karl Fischer, actor-vortex-karl) classifies as CRITICAL severity.
8D corrective action sub-process is spawned.
Deviation is closed after corrective action.
via: api for all steps (simulating MES calls).

SCENARIO 2 — vortex-supplier-quality-deviation-false-positive.yaml (compensation)
Title: "Supplier quality deviation: false positive — batch released from quarantine"
A Quality Engineer logs a deviation. Quarantine fires.
Quality Manager classifies, marks false_positive=true.
The batch is released from quarantine (compensation fires).
Deviation is voided.
via: api.

SCENARIO 3 — vortex-production-order-above-threshold.yaml (happy + timer escalation)
Title: "Production order >€10k approved by Finance Controller"
Planner creates production order with value €15,000 (above €10k threshold).
Production Manager reviews capacity and approves.
Timer fires after timeout (system action).
Financial Controller signs off on budget.
Production line is assigned and execution begins.
via: api steps. Test that the finance sign-off is enforced at €15,000.

MANDATORY BUSINESS RULES from BO-VORTEX agent instructions:
- Quarantine MUST appear BEFORE severity classification (ISO 9001).
- CRITICAL deviation MUST spawn 8D sub-process.
- Finance sign-off MUST be required for order >€10,000.
- False-positive compensation MUST release the batch from quarantine.
acceptance_criteria: Scenario YAML files created at tests/simulation/scenarios/vortex-supplier-quality-deviation-critical.yaml.yaml and vortex-supplier-quality-deviation-false-positive.yaml.yaml (or vortex-production-order-above-threshold.yaml.yaml if three)
Each scenario follows the schema from docs/agents/uat-scenario-schema.md
Mandatory business rules from BO agent instructions are tested
Via field contains realistic API instructions for each step
Cleanup section removes any test artifacts

result.summary: Authored 3 Vortex UAT scenarios: critical deviation path, false-positive compensation path, production-order-above-threshold boundary test
result.next_action: Route to UAT-RUNNER for schema validation (WF-06 Step 1b)
